input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 (branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a run's launch config carries grading_enabled, off when missing, through the ordered launch delivery (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts). T2: settlement of an evaluation execution is fenced to the exact current claim, and completion appends its observation in one transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts, observation/src/grading/worker.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #791 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #791, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/791 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/worker.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.
input.title: Automatic grading lifecycle audit

risks.mitigation: Run once and preserve actual output; apply the known-issue rule without inventing results.
Add and report the oakridge-dbos suite separately.
risks.description: The sole prescribed suite omits T1's direct tests.

risks.mitigation: Assess the pinned head; two concerns are addressed there and the generated-contract split was explicitly deferred. Do not mutate threads.
risks.description: The merged PR retains three open threads, which can be mistaken for current defects.

body.summary: Implementable with no blockers. PR #791 is merged and resolves to db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef. The named code supports both tasks. Pin that SHA and add the oakridge-dbos suite so test evidence covers T1 as well as T2.

findings.description: The prescribed observation command invokes only observation/package.json:6-8. T1 tests are in oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83 and oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65, reached through oakridge-dbos/package.json:7-11; required builder test_evidence therefore does not directly substantiate T1.

The spec names a branch rather than an immutable SHA. Local and gated-review metadata agree on merged PR head db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef. A branch move or deletion could change or prevent checkout.

T1 is auditable: grading defaults false and rejects malformed values (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-41); committed launch config is emitted beside input with none/malformed states preserved (oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:14-49).

Current-claim fencing checks status, owner, attempt, and lease after locking, then repeats the predicate on update (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:194-228); the worker carries that claim through settlement (observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95).

Completion updates execution and attempt and inserts the observation in one settlement transaction (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:248-292), with rollback and commit behavior tested (observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244).

requirements.description: Produce exactly one audit cohort with T1 and T2 and no new operator choice.
Assess default-off grading_enabled and exact launch-config delivery.
Assess exact-claim fencing and atomic completion plus observation append.
Inspect detached PR head without mutations, report actual tests, and publish existing PR #791.
Assess the same commit with source-ranged findings and separate test/output evidence.

source_spec_refs: One audit cohort with T1 and T2

proposed_spec_updates.change: Run bun run --filter oakridge-dbos test once and bun run --filter observation test once, publishing separate actual counts/output and retaining the no-invention rule.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: T1 direct tests are outside the observation suite.

proposed_spec_updates.change: Pin db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef as the merged PR head; verify the branch resolves to it, detach at that SHA, and retain PR #791 as the authorized PR artifact.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: Prevents branch movement/deletion or merged state from changing the audit.
